title: Pi Coding Agent Plugins: Local RAG & Persistent Terminal
date_basis: canonical public page exposed relative 4mo only; exact date was not asserted
summary: 作者介绍两个 Pi Coding Agent 插件：Local BM25 RAG 为本地文件建立索引并按关键词检索；Persistent Terminal 在 Pi 内保留 PTY、当前目录、virtualenv 与环境变量，区别于内置 bash 每次启动新的 subshell。
why_useful: 提供本地检索与跨命令终端状态持久化的具体 Pi 扩展设计，并清楚说明它们相对默认工具行为解决的问题。
discovery_backend: bounded discovery from LinkedIn ordinary public relevant-post surfaces
readback_backend: bounded ordinary guest-visible canonical LinkedIn public post in in-app browser
limitations: 插件能力、BM25 检索质量、PTY 隔离与安全性均为作者自述，本轮未安装或复现；页面只显示相对时间 4mo，确切日期保持 unknown。未登录、未互动。
readback_evidence: Canonical guest page visibly showed Vahid Kowsari and the full post body describing a local BM25 RAG plugin plus a persistent terminal plugin that preserves cwd, virtualenv and environment variables, explicitly contrasting it with Pi's built-in bash tool starting a fresh subshell. The page showed relative 4mo only.
